gate_target.authority_note: This is the P20 proposed automated DEV target; this package does not issue a Gate verdict.

oracle_independence.rule: Expected values are frozen before production mutation. The production SUT, codec, normalizer, OrderKey allocator, planner, Scene compiler or runtime round-trip must not be used as the sole expected-value oracle.

obligations.requirement: Schema, wire and inherited publication; preserve accepted source fields and exact Section/1 and Operation 17/18 bytes.
obligations.oracle: Hand-authored typed expectations and byte fixtures, accepted-IDL descriptor delta, and preimage comparison.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable W01-W07 variant matches frozen expectation; exact accepted descriptor is additive; inherited fields and historical descriptor.lock remain unchanged; no silent skip or unsupported positive.
obligations.failure_mode: Protocol corruption or loss of inherited fields.

obligations.requirement: Atomic topology, complete guarded graph writes and all-or-nothing rejection.
obligations.oracle: Literal final-object tables, independent flat-map/parent-graph reference traversal, and precommit failure snapshots.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable T01-T07 variant matches; no partial membership, cycles, orphan records, stale-guard writes, or canonical/History mutation on precommit rejection.
obligations.failure_mode: Partial membership, cycles, orphan records, or lost concurrent changes.

obligations.requirement: Real F/U admission, byte budgets, History reservation, Undo/Redo and failure atomicity.
obligations.oracle: Actual forward/inverse wire values metered independently; saved canonical touched fields; staged inverse applicability; bounded precommit fault schedule.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable H01-H08 variant matches; real F and U each obey accepted limits, required resources are reserved before commit, History/redo remain unchanged on rejection, Undo/Redo use fresh operation IDs and preserve monotonic canonical metadata.
obligations.failure_mode: Forward succeeds but Undo is impossible, redo is destructive, or duplicate History is emitted.

obligations.requirement: Affine reparent, Section boundary resize and numeric quality boundary.
obligations.oracle: Independently ordered IEEE-754 binary64 reference with authored dyadic literals and precomputed non-dyadic reference components.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable G01-G06 variant matches exact ordered arithmetic and accepted P12 quality predicate; no cumulative transform drift, resize-induced child movement, or hidden tolerance change.
obligations.failure_mode: Reparent jump, cumulative transform drift, or resize moving contents.

obligations.requirement: Container selection producer, Section full-containment and existing Group scope.
obligations.oracle: Authored polygons and expected ID/root sets, exact containment, and child-first point cases.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable S01-S06 variant matches; concave containment uses the actual region rather than only corners/AABB; common FC01A set algebra and Group scope remain intact.
obligations.failure_mode: Wrong selected root causes unintended batch edit/delete.

obligations.requirement: Scene, world geometry, bounds, render order, damage, opacity and recovery.
obligations.oracle: Literal world/damage expectations, coherent observer snapshots, draw list and interior-pixel reference.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable V01-V05 variant matches; child overflow remains visible/queryable, opacity and clipping are correct, and failed projection cannot duplicate a canonical commit or report false cancellation.
obligations.failure_mode: Overflow becomes invisible, hit index is stale, or publication is partial.

obligations.requirement: Preview handoff and delayed local effects.
obligations.oracle: Deterministic scheduled observation trace with fixed valid/invalid timelines and positive completion assertions.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable C01-C05 variant matches; no transient double-transform or late callback overwrites current selection; recovery completes with a coherent projection and preview exits when required.
obligations.failure_mode: Double-drawn transform or stale local callback overwrites new selection.

obligations.requirement: Control identity, lifecycle, ingress, cancellation and queue/receipt boundaries.
obligations.oracle: Controlled ingress/owner scheduling with independent state, counter and receipt snapshots.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable L01-L06 variant matches; full identities are preserved, stale/cancelled inputs cannot commit, and queue/receipt limits fail closed without partial mutation.
obligations.failure_mode: Wrong object/document mutation or late Up after cancellation.

obligations.requirement: Snapshot, journal replay, capability/version and writer compatibility.
obligations.oracle: Fixed capability/version truth table, canonical digest inputs, and independent state before/after unknown input.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable K01-K06 variant matches; restore/replay is atomic, unknown operation or missing capability fails closed, old-reader/writer claims are tied to actual behavior, and writer admission cannot be inferred from snapshot read success.
obligations.failure_mode: Silent partial load/replay or invalid writer participation.

obligations.oracle: Ordinary compiled consumer and actual Windows/WASM adapter probes compared with literal expectations, plus applicable retained regressions.
obligations.acceptance: Every applicable P01-P04 variant matches; full IDs and typed readback/receipt behavior survive the public facade and platform bridge; mixed-default-delete rejects before write; actual browser execution is recorded.
obligations.failure_mode: Demo-only implementation, truncated IDs, or partially executed mixed Delete.

profile_policy.execution_rule: Use the exact accepted external matrix for every variant/profile; original variant index remains unchanged. NOT_APPLICABLE, NOT_RUN and BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT are distinct.
profile_policy.browser_rule: P02 and public Web adapter cases require actual Chrome/WASM execution. Node-only, mock bridge, or build-only evidence cannot substitute.
profile_policy.independence_rule: Windows and Web repeats establish profile realization and adapter parity, not two independent semantic oracles.

shared_acceptance_rules: NOT_RUN is never PASS; no required positive may be skipped as Unsupported.
An expected Unsupported negative is PASS only when every zero-mutation and receipt assertion also holds.
Every result binds exact subject revision, runner revision, oracle revision, profile, toolchain, invocation, input/expected hashes and raw observed artifacts.
The evidence head and qualification subject revision are separate when evidence-only commits differ.
No expected value may be derived from the product SUT or recorded from its output.
No summary label, discovery count, build success or qualification hook observation substitutes for product behavior.

retained_obligations.base_01: Preserve accepted source fields and historical descriptor.lock; publish only the source-complete additive current descriptor.
retained_obligations.int_01: FC04/FC10 retains full integration ownership; FC08 must explicitly reject mixed-default-delete before any write.

historical_materialization_only: Old runner/probe artifacts remain bound as historical observations, never substituted for new product RED.
